movie.title: Turbulence
movie.overview: Young married couple Zach and Emmy decide to take a hot air balloon trip across the Italian Dolomites to rekindle their relationship. When they and pilot Harry are joined by a third passenger, Julia, events unfold in ways they could never imagine five thousand meters in the air.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
What makes a good survivalist thriller work? Simply put, you find youself rooting for the main characters, you invest in them, you want them to live, against the odds stacked against them. What if the main characters, are horrible, dysfunctional people? Well, there's the exact problem, with "Turbulence".

The husband and wife characters are damaged, homicidally awful types, as is the female blackmailer, who hitches a ride.  Kelsey Grammer's, "Harry" is the only likable, person in this tawdry bunch but he quickly reaches his "expiry date", leaving the new cast "Dirty Rotten Scoundrels" to try and do each other in, high in the wind, rain and clouds.

In summary, in spite of some decent thrills, the lack of likability of the key protagonists, combined with their generally cruel and ruthless behaviour, robs this film of its potential. A mediocre watch, at best.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
Mostly empty, with a lack of tension
This is not Fall. Let's just start there. There is a lot less here than Fall has. And this has twice the cast.

It builds its tension, but not very soundly, and does some strange character reveals later on that seem a bit jarring. The protagonists are unlikable, the antagonist nonsensical, and Kelsey is just wooden. Luckily some parts are smaller than others.

It is not just hot air, or vacuous, which would be appropriate for a movie about a balloon, but it isn't very substantial.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A struggling young couple's romantic hot air balloon ride over the Italian Dolomites turns into a high-altitude fight for survival when an unexpected fourth passenger triggers a series of terrifying events.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Hoping to rekindle their fraying marriage, Zach and Emmy embark on a scenic hot air balloon tour across the breathtaking Italian Dolomites. Accompanied by their pilot, Harry, the couple's quiet getaway is upended when a mysterious third passenger, Julia, joins the flight. Suspicion and tension quickly escalate thousands of meters above the ground, forcing everyone aboard to navigate both human deceit and perilous airborne conditions. As dark secrets emerge, what was meant to be a romantic journey becomes a desperate struggle to reach the ground alive.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Zach and Emmy are a young married couple facing a deep rift in their relationship, prompting them to book a hot air balloon excursion across the stunning peaks of the Italian Dolomites in a desperate attempt to reconnect. Under the guidance of their experienced pilot, Harry, the ride promises peace, isolation, and unforgettable views high above the mountainous terrain. However, the dynamics shift drastically when Julia, an enigmatic last-minute addition, joins the voyage with motives that remain unclear. As the balloon ascends to a harrowing altitude of five thousand meters, subtle tensions between the passengers rapidly escalate into open conflict and mistrust. Julia's unexpected presence acts as a catalyst, unraveling secrets that Zach and Emmy have kept hidden from each other while putting the entire group in immediate danger. Trapped in a tiny basket floating miles above the Earth, the group must contend with severe weather, mechanical failure, and rising hostility within the group. Harry struggles to maintain control of the aircraft as sabotage and betrayal threaten to plunge the balloon into the jagged peaks below. Every decision becomes life-or-death as physical endurance and mental stability are pushed to the absolute limit. Ultimately, Zach and Emmy are forced to confront the harsh truths of their bond while fighting side by side to outwit a deadly threat in the sky.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hoping to repair their strained relationship, Zach and Emmy travel to Italy for a romantic hot air balloon voyage over the jagged, magnificent peaks of the Dolomites. Guided by seasoned pilot Harry, the peaceful flight takes a chilling turn when a enigmatic stranger named Julia unexpectedly boards the basket with them. Soaring thousands of meters above the mountain range, mysterious tensions and hidden agendas surface among the passengers, transforming a serene skyward getaway into a claustrophobic, high-stakes crisis where trust is low and the margin for error is non-existent.
